scope: All Git-tracked executable source and build-control files under scripts, both Explorer applications and checked-in workflow/impact configuration; root build controls; executable tests under tests and both Explorer test trees.
exclusions: Non-executable test fixtures and evidence data

meaning.complete-source-read: The source was read, not a claim of exhaustive semantic proof, branch coverage or a fresh test pass.
meaning.targeted-source-review: The listed ranges were directly inspected in context, with whole-file structural/function inventory. Remaining bodies are not closed review coverage.
meaning.structural-only: File inventoried and structural or routing patterns checked; not substantive function-by-function source-review completion.

verification_boundary: No live provider or AI client, full test suite or deployment was run. Baseline fingerprints describe reviewed code; documentation-only corrections do not change these code fingerprints.
